classification: Exploratory numerical sensitivities; no validation pass or engineering benefit claim.

diagnostic_definitions.floor_contact: The event records the raw pressure-corrector minimum and liquid support associated with applying pMin; it is not mass removed from the inventory. The final stored field minimum is separately recorded.
diagnostic_definitions.linear_iterations: Counts in the private solver-log profile are linear-solver No Iterations counters, not CPU or wall shares.
diagnostic_definitions.mass_ledger: Water/gas inventory and cumulative defects are reported separately; defect fractions use the run's initial inventory.
diagnostic_definitions.time_metrics: OpenFOAM ExecutionTime is calling-rank process CPU time; ClockTime is elapsed wall time. Merged logs may include MPI prefixes and integer-second ClockTime values.

history_note: Cold-start-derived finite-water EOS runs that restart near 0.05 s, the warm .400019820001 scheme pair, and the warm .460047515286 continuations (including the maxDeltaT=25 microsecond branch) are separate histories. Do not read them as one converged trajectory.
limitations: Terminal states arise from distinct initial histories, numerical settings, and safety/diagnostic stops.
100 Pa pressure-update screens are exploratory guard criteria, not validation tolerances.
A raw pressure-floor contact is not the same as a final stored field below pMin.
Linear iteration counts do not measure time share; ClockTime is coarse in these logs.
The common-time N8/N16 comparison interpolates N16 health rows onto N8 physical timestamps.
dT=0 in the logged outer-state delta is not evidence of nonlinear energy closure.
The maxDeltaT=25 microsecond floor-contact case is a 0.475 ms warm-restart sensitivity; it is not evidence that a smaller timestep is less accurate or less stable on a cold-start trajectory.

matched_warm_scheme_control.interpretation: Matched warm-seed comparison; any scheme-only equivalence claim is conditional on the exact frozen dictionaries and does not establish a converged physical trajectory.

n8_n16_common_physical_time.interpretation: This is a short warm-state sensitivity at matched physical times; the cases share the same pre-GO .460047515286 s seed but have different terminal times and guard stops.
n8_n16_common_physical_time.method: N8 native step-health timestamps; N16 linearly interpolated between its adjacent logged time samples.

pre_go_seed_comparison.phase_temperature_scope: Hashes are from the immutable pre-GO seed; DCEC startup may regenerate phase-specific T.air/T.water from common T after GO.

restart_dgdt_source_note.alpha_source: solvers/i4f_frozen_sp/applications/solvers/multiphase/compressibleInterFoam/alphaSuSp.H:25-36 builds Su/Sp from dgdt before the pressure equation updates it.
restart_dgdt_source_note.createFields: solvers/i4f_frozen_sp/applications/solvers/multiphase/compressibleInterFoam/createFields.H:90 constructs dgdt from alpha1*fvc::div(phi) at solver initialization; dgdt is not loaded as a separately persisted restart field.
restart_dgdt_source_note.interpretation: This is shared restart-startup behavior from the current restart phi. It may explain a small first-source-step reset, but does not by itself explain a later plateau or establish energy closure.

source.transonic_off_interpretation: Source retains explicit phase continuity in both branches; transonic=false omits the implicit pressure-convection correction terms. It does not remove gas compressibility.

first_raw_pressure_contact.interpretation: diagnostic support of the raw corrector floor operation, not mass removed from the inventory

warm_dt25us_restart_interpretation.interpretation: This is a short warm-restart sensitivity that stopped at a raw pressure-floor contact within 0.475 ms of the checkpoint. It is not a cold-start time-convergence result and does not show that the smaller timestep cap makes the physics worse. DCEC restart initialization reconstructs dgdt and phase density/flux state from the stored checkpoint fields, so this short response is conditional on that warm-start reconstruction.
warm_dt25us_restart_interpretation.only_declared_governing_change: maxDeltaT reduced from 0.00025 s to 0.000025 s; adjustTimeStep, deltaT, maxCo, maxAlphaCo and all other frozen inputs retained.

warm_n8_n16_outer_corrector_pair.only_declared_change: PIMPLE.nOuterCorrectors 8 -> 16; common pre-GO .460047515286 seed, upwind, transonic yes, nCorrectors=2, water EOS, source, and audit=false.

warm_n8_transonic_linearization_pair.only_declared_change: PIMPLE.transonic yes -> no; nOuterCorrectors=8, nCorrectors=2, upwind, and other matched warm inputs are retained.
